name: Girl Dracula
source:
The mistress of darkness herself, Girl Dracula wants what any vampire wants; to rule over mortals through fear and power! She loves boasting about her great accomplishments and numerous vampiric abilities. But could there be more to her underneath the surface...?

[From [url=https://air-gong.itch.io/the-intern-of-christmas-present]Itch.io[/url]]
